dedupe_keys.name: high resolution dataset for a danish educational building aau and the swiss nest building with submeter and room measurements

description: This dataset gives detailed operational data for two buildings: an educational building of Aalborg University in Denmark that houses its built-environment department, and Empa's NEST research building in Dübendorf, Switzerland, which contains apartments, offices and other units. It was produced by Aalborg University and Empa and described in a 2026 Data in Brief article. It contains room measurements, main and sub meters for space heating, electricity and domestic hot water, ventilation data and HVAC control signals at 1 to 10 minute resolution, with outdoor measurements. Access: version 3 on Zenodo, 2 June 2026, as zip files per system (the indoor file is about 1.5 GB) with an overview workbook. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: two buildings only; sensor coverage differs between them. Simulation uses: calibrating and validating building energy models, testing model predictive control and fault detection, and digital-twin prototypes. Related records: LBNL Building 59 dataset and the GECAD smart building datasets.
